name: l2cap_register_psm_handler

ownership.argument: Public register half of the PSM registry; the find half is l2cap_find_le_psm 0xC7FF644 and the remove half is l2cap_unregister_psm_handler 0xC8030F0. All three use the same key at entry+4 (u16 psm) and entry+6 (kind).

provenance.source: Submitted by the public wrapper 0xC805A80. Inserts the entry into the registry at *(owner)+16 with 0xC7EAC34, then for kind 2 (LE) assigns a PSM from the dynamic range starting 0x1001 and for kind 3 from 0x0080..0x00FF, rewriting entry+4 and rescanning the registry by (psm, kind) until a free slot is found, and finishes by notifying through the callback stored at the entry.
